title: UX-011 keyboard and accessibility probe

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given USER-A has the dialog labelled "User Profile" on the Home page visible
2. When USER-A presses "Tab" through a complete navigation cycle inside the dialog labelled "User Profile" on the Home page
3. Then The forward focus trace contains no element outside the User Profile dialog
4. When USER-A presses "Shift+Tab" through a complete navigation cycle inside the dialog labelled "User Profile" on the Home page
5. Then The reverse focus trace contains no element outside the User Profile dialog

annotations.description: Actual React shell. Controlled catalog, user identity, photo failures, and SystemJS tenant. Chromium only. Accessibility and layout outcomes are proposed probes; no approved conformance standard is inferred.

limits: The recorded assertions and environment binding limit the supported business result.
